scope: saved evidence only; no benchmarks, compilers, or native workloads rerun
statistical_method: Exact Fraction interpolation of sorted integer ns at p*(n-1), inclusive Q1/median/Q3; ratios of engine medians. IQR overlap is descriptive, not a significance test.

comparison_families.application: Rewritten application on current Relar and CPython; preserved old application on baseline Relar. Changes combine source and compiler/runtime effects.
comparison_families.common-source: Exact old application on current Relar, preserved Relar, and CPython. Current-versus-preserved Relar holds application source fixed.

cross_family_caveat: Families are sequential measurement batches; direct cross-family source-effect ratios are not paired or causal estimates.

scope.compiler_provenance_scope: Final parent-reported workspace build on the clean committed source; every compiled Rust/Cargo input rechecked against HEAD before and after freeze. No pre-build capture is claimed here.
scope.build_environment_scope: Explicit wrapper settings and parent-reported ordinary command; observed ambient flags at freeze are recorded separately, not claimed as a historical environment capture.
